q2_gaps: a descriptively modified bare plural object in a HABITUAL clause ("orders new domes"): the instruction set prescribes the bare kind filler for non-specific / kind-level objects and reserves the existential group witness for episodic clauses, but only the group witness can carry the modifier "new" (fusing new_dome is barred as incidental description, and dropping the modifier is barred outright)

a manner-like PP on an event ("in batches") has no stated route: Manner is restricted to how-adverbs, so it falls to the preposition-named oblique In, which is used here for what is not really an aboutness or containment relation
notes: Singular "the village" correctly stays one participant with no distribution, the unmarked present is right for the habitual reading, and Theme is the right object role for "order". The group witness for "new domes" over-commits to a specific set, but it is the only modifier-carrying option the instruction set leaves open.
